src: upper 6x6 template region and lower red marker mask separated by a grey row
transform: compress each 2x2 block of the template to one cell; expand each lower mask pixel to a 3x3 output block, stamping the compressed tile only at red marker positions and leaving other blocks background
symbol_instructions: upper template region encodes the 3x3 tile; lower red mask encodes the coarse output positions that receive the tile
